name: websume-app
description: Websume — full-stack scaffold. client/ (React+Vite) pairs with either server/ (Node+Express+SQLite, local dev) or worker/ (Cloudflare Workers+Hono+D1, production on Cloudflare).

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.install:worker: npm install --prefix worker && npm install --prefix client
scripts.deploy:worker: npm run build --prefix client && npm run deploy --prefix worker
